objective: Continuously discover, test, rank, release and evaluate improvements across data, methods, products, security, accessibility, reliability and public utility without allowing automated expansion to weaken IGRM's truth boundary.

launch_floor_policy.principle: The roadmap may expand continuously; achieved public capability may not silently shrink.

cadence.target: Inspect registered evidence for source freshness, coverage gaps, contract drift, broken routes, performance regressions, security signals, competitor-capability gaps and unresolved user journeys.
cadence.publication: Read-only audit artifact. It cannot change public code, data, methods or claims.

cadence.target: Run semantic, provenance, rights, security, accessibility, responsive, performance and regression tests against each proposed change.
cadence.publication: A change remains ineligible until every registered blocking gate passes.

cadence.target: Release bounded improvements that passed their authority and exact-commit gates; publish the resulting capability and coverage delta.
cadence.publication: Atomic release with rollback evidence. No quota to ship when nothing passed.

cadence.target: Review the highest-impact gaps, user failures, benchmark losses, stale assumptions and rival-product capabilities.
cadence.publication: Public improvement ledger and loss register update.

cadence.target: Challenge constructs, weights, source frames, comparability, model performance and historical drift on frozen evidence.
cadence.publication: Methods change only through a new version and its registered study or correction path.

cadence.target: Re-evaluate whether IGRM is solving the right problems, add new capability families and retire superseded implementation paths without reducing the public floor.
cadence.publication: New north-star version, denominator delta and explicit non-goals.

quality_dimensions.question: Did accuracy, calibration, construct validity, uncertainty or refusal behaviour improve?
quality_dimensions.minimum_evidence: Adversarial tests or a registered external study appropriate to the claim.

quality_dimensions.question: Did a declared source, language, country, entity, time or dependency denominator improve?
quality_dimensions.minimum_evidence: Before/after numerator and unchanged or explicitly versioned denominator.

quality_dimensions.question: Can a named user complete a real task more accurately, quickly or transparently?
quality_dimensions.minimum_evidence: Task definition and measured outcome; aesthetic preference alone is insufficient.

quality_dimensions.question: Did clarity, information architecture, interaction, accessibility, mobile use or low-bandwidth use improve?
Did freshness, atomicity, recovery, observability, performance or service delivery improve?
quality_dimensions.minimum_evidence: Operational measurement or tested failure/recovery path.

quality_dimensions.question: Did attack surface, secret isolation, data minimization, abuse resistance or incident recovery improve?
quality_dimensions.minimum_evidence: Threat-linked control plus a failing-then-passing adversarial test.

quality_dimensions.question: Can an independent user locate, verify, reproduce and cite more of the result?
quality_dimensions.minimum_evidence: Authenticated artifact, exact procedure and isolated verification.

quality_dimensions.question: Did external review, contribution, integration, documented use or continuity improve?
quality_dimensions.minimum_evidence: External evidence; agents and the founder cannot self-manufacture adoption.

strategic_programs.objective: Create a point-in-time global event and episode census that separates observations, unique events and multi-event episodes and preserves hierarchy, lifecycle, disagreement and correction history.
strategic_programs.proof: A frozen source frame and country/time denominator reconcile; event, episode and observation counts remain distinct; syndication cannot manufacture corroboration; every revision replays and exposes its dependent-product blast radius.

strategic_programs.objective: Reconstruct exactly what each registered source and release could support at a knowledge cutoff without importing later evidence.
strategic_programs.proof: Vintage, outage, revision and contradiction tests refuse future leakage and reproduce historical source states from authenticated evidence.

strategic_programs.objective: Expand Atlas from an India-partner event map into a complete-country, multi-domain geopolitical consequence system.
strategic_programs.proof: Every registered geometry renders; every layer publishes its denominator and unavailable members; real values require source and rights gates.

strategic_programs.objective: Turn the 1979-present record into regime baselines, analog search, structural-break diagnostics, event archetypes and knowledge-cutoff replay rather than one archival chart.
strategic_programs.proof: Each new historical use states its construct and comparability boundary and is evaluated against a simpler baseline.

strategic_programs.objective: Maintain declared, versioned universes for India's external dependencies, capacities, buffers and unmapped gaps.
strategic_programs.proof: Every universe reconciles its complete input frame and independently sampled mappings.

strategic_programs.objective: Bring every public page to one institutional design, accessibility, performance and evidence standard.
strategic_programs.proof: All protected routes pass cross-viewport, console, keyboard, screen-reader, low-bandwidth and claim-integrity checks.

strategic_programs.objective: Show whether IGRM helps researchers, businesses, journalists and public institutions make defined decisions better.
strategic_programs.proof: Preregistered blinded tasks, independent users, declared baselines and permanent losses.

strategic_programs.objective: Compile research, board, newsroom, public, API and offline-audit products from one governed consequence chain.
strategic_programs.proof: Every visible clause resolves to the same claim and evidence bundle across products; orphan, stale, rights-incompatible or temporally invalid plans refuse.

strategic_programs.objective: Separate descriptive aftermath, compatible mechanisms, causal attribution and robust feasible options under uncertainty.
strategic_programs.proof: Registered mechanisms publish rival hypotheses, falsifiers and identifiability status; scenarios propagate intervals and respect stocks, flows, capacity, substitution and timing constraints.

current_automation_boundary.reason: A self-modifying public research instrument without bounded authority, independent gates and rollback evidence would optimize visible motion rather than truth.
current_automation_boundary.next_gate: Ship a read-only hourly scout, public improvement ledger and measured promotion/rollback state before considering any bounded automatic release class.
